title: Downtown Dallas in an afternoon
description: Three classic spots. Drop a bugg at each to earn the badge.

spots.name: Klyde Warren Park
spots.why: Food trucks at lunch and something on the lawn most evenings.

spots.name: Reunion Tower
spots.why: The ball lights up after dark, and the view from the top is the best in town.

spots.name: Deep Ellum
spots.why: Murals by day, live music by night.
